name: Matchmaker and dating coach

pf.license.need: No license is needed for this work in most places. A registration or certificate the state asks for is the business's own to add. It is optional, and nothing is looked up.
pf.license.ask: Any registration, certificate or insurance the business wants shown, as the business's own word.
pf.license.who holds it: The business. No person license is needed by default.
pf.license.how it's checked: Rosie checks none of it and never says it was checked. Anything shown is the business's own word.
pf.license.blocks going live: Nothing. Licenses and insurance are optional and never block going live.
pf.license.never claimed: Rosie never says a license, certificate or insurance is confirmed; anything shown is the business's own word.
pf.license.insurance or bond: The business's own choice, shown only as its own word.

pf.services.shape: Matchmaking and dating coaching: sessions by video or phone and at the office (flow A), and a date-prep visit at a client's home or a dating talk at a host's place (flow B). Every new client starts with a free intro call. Matches are never booked by Rosie: each match is arranged by the matchmaker with both people's yes.

pf.questions.who may book: An adult for themselves. Adults only: anyone under 18 is not booked, and a parent may not book for an adult.

stop.words: someone in danger or hurt right now, on a date or anywhere
stop.say: If anyone is in danger, call 911, or the local emergency number. Leave the place and get to a safe spot first.

stop.words: a request to find, track or follow another person, or to get their address or phone
stop.say: Rosie can't help with that. If someone is in danger, call 911.

goOn.words: a match who has blocked the client, or a client who is being chased by a former partner
goOn.what: nothing is passed on; the matchmaker stops that introduction and the client is given the local safety line.

pf.safety.never answered: Relationship, mental-health, legal and safety advice: the matchmaker says that isn't matchmaking, and points to a licensed person.
pf.safety.never said: No promise that a match will be a good one, or a set number of dates.

required.name: The matchmaker's terms and the privacy agreement
required.who: the client, on the secure page
required.result: signed: on file for later visits

pf.first_steps.prep for the reminder: Have your goals, your pace and your partner preferences written down, and the time for the meeting.

pf.visit.check-in: At the office: the code at the desk. By video or phone: the matchmaker asks for the code at the start. At home: the code at the door.
pf.visit.at the visit: The matchmaker goes over the plan. No match is shared with a client by Rosie, and none is shown on the booking.
pf.visit.work changes: Extra time at a session is priced and OK'd before it's added.
pf.visit.what proves it's done: The code, or DONE when the meeting ends.

pf.money.before: A dating coaching session: paid in full when booked (refunded 24 hours or more before). A follow-up or a home visit: a card saved. A matchmaking package: a deposit now, the rest after. Dating talks: nothing taken.
pf.money.after: The saved card is charged when the matchmaker texts DONE; a matchmaking package's rest goes to the front desk or the bill; a dating talk pays at the desk or the bill.
pf.money.matches: Never through Rosie: no fee for a match, and no payment between clients.
pf.money.fees: Late-cancel fee: $20 (a follow-up) or $89 (a home visit), only with the matchmaker's OK; no fee on silence.
pf.money.tax: None by default; the state form says if the service is taxed there.

pf.messages.never in a text: Anything a client shares about a relationship, a match, health, money or sexual preferences; a match's name, photo, job, address or phone; and when a home will be empty.
pf.messages.card or photo texted by mistake: Not kept or passed on; the client is told once where it goes instead (the secure page).
pf.messages.staff texts: the client's initials and the kind of visit; details on the secure page

pf.staff.roles: Matchmakers (some with coaching training), a front desk person.
pf.staff.licenses: None needed. Training is the matchmaker's own word, shown as stated.
pf.staff.who OKs: Sam OKs any price made for one client.
pf.staff.stand-ins: Another matchmaker who knows the client's goals; a client who asked for their matchmaker by name is asked first; nobody moves on silence.
pf.staff.after hours: None: bookings are by text or on the page.

pf.rules.matching: Rosie never passes one client's name, photo, job, address or phone to another client, and never books two clients together. A match is arranged by the matchmaker, with both people's yes, on the secure page.
pf.rules.matchmaking: Matchmaking isn't therapy or legal advice; the matchmaker says so when asked. Matches are never sold through Rosie. A photo is kept only with the client's yes.

matter most.a request to find or track another perso: Rosie can't help; 911 if anyone is in danger.
matter most.a match who has blocked the client: The introduction stops; nothing is passed on.
matter most.a meeting that feels unsafe: The client leaves; 911 if anyone is in danger. A first date is only in a public place.
matter most.a late cancel: The fee only with the matchmaker's OK; no fee on silence.
matter most.a profile photo sent: Used only for the review; not shared.

pf.edges.the rest: All other edge cases are handled the generic way.
